keyword: skincare routine for dry skin in India
quick: For dry skin in India, wash with a gentle cream cleanser, apply a hydrating layer on damp skin, then a cream moisturiser and sunscreen in the morning. At night, cleanse, hydrate and seal with a nourishing night cream. Avoid hot water and daily scrubs.
facts: Apply moisturiser on slightly damp skin.
Good dry skin creams mix humectants and emollients.
Hot water and bathing soap strip oil quickly.
Sunscreen is still needed in Indian winters.
